tip: Fronting the adjective, Hir yw, adds emphasis, common in proverbs. Neutral order is mae pob aros yn hir, all waiting is long.
Add -ach for the comparative. iach means healthy, so bwyta'n iachach means to eat healthier.
To bring is dod â, literally come with. Here dod â diodydd means bring drinks.
Welsh has no verb to have. Mae beic coch gan Megan is a red bike is with Megan, meaning Megan has one.
After mae gen i, I have, the thing owned soft mutates. teulu becomes deulu in gen i deulu.
drwy, through, triggers soft mutation. cerddoriaeth becomes gerddoriaeth in drwy gerddoriaeth.
heb plus a verb means not having done it. heb ffonio here is hadn't called, the negative of wedi ffonio.
Unreal conditions pair Pe bawn i, if I were, with byddwn i, I would. Both take the same -wn ending.
For a negative condition, add na after pe. Pe na bawn i wedi colli means if I hadn't missed.
An adjective after predicative yn soft mutates. trist becomes drist in yn drist, sad.
The word yn, in, triggers nasal mutation and itself becomes yng. canol turns into yng nghanol, in the middle of.
gyda, with, triggers aspirate mutation. tro becomes thro in gyda thro annisgwyl, with a twist.
After a form of gallu, can, the following verb soft mutates. gwahanu becomes wahanu in allwch wahanu.
